g.text: Eleven ways to evaluate an LLM, grouped into four families
The families split on one question: what counts as the ground truth?
measure how far the answer strays from a gold answer
of what it said, how much is in the reference
of the reference, how much is in the answer
compare by meaning, not by characters
Let a model do the grading
no reference — hand another LLM the criteria
unfold criteria into steps, then score
put two side by side, pick a winner
two things that hold steady when auto-grading wobbles
the reference point every metric must match
a decision tree of yes/no branches
Look at behaviour, not the answer
score the path, the conversation and the risk
the steps the agent actually took
the whole conversation as one unit
Going down, the question shifts from "did it get it right" to "does this work as a product"
